يتعاطين (form VI)
# يَتَعَاطَيْنَ (yataʕāṭayna) /ja.ta.ʕaː.tˤaj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
# يُتَعَاطَيْنَ (yutaʕāṭayna) /ju.ta.ʕaː.tˤaj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
